notes: ACS multi-agent-hotload adopter state for Pukujan/Eval-lab (TASK-0067, issue #90). Full four-component move to the current certified train: FULL PCM 0.7.0 (851bcf72, CLI 0.7.0) + FULL CGM 0.5.12 (62340f3d, eight modules) + OIO 0.1.0 (a4bba77b) + ACS hotload 0.2.0 (25be219b, module 0.1.0). The train's ACS entry is 589b0a97, but that commit's own stack-mesh.json still requires PCM 197f7ba8 / CGM b487b48c and so refuses the train's own PCM/CGM; 25be219b carries the mesh that matches the live train and is the mesh-consistent commit (mesh.py --check passes on it, fails on 589b0a97). stack-manifest.json follows release train 'current'. OIO managed content is unchanged from the prior install (byte-identical modulo line endings) and is recorded here for traceability. Boss lease is minutes (30; range 15-120); the watchdog is agent-less and liveness-only. The decision-boss seat is vacant until the first live continuer claims it.

role_fill.notes: First continuer = decision boss; next = coder1; next = coder2.

agents.notes: Seed hint for an empty room only; live join/continue order wins. Tool identity does not assign roles.

watchdog.notes: AGENT-LESS. Cron/Action/script only. No LLM. No peer agent. Watchdog != failover. ~10m liveness/nudge only.

cgm.notes: FULL CGM 0.5.12 required for ACS and all hotloader adopters. Eight modules including human-output-naming. Not HSW+writing-direction only. MUST load modules per writing-routing.json (README→writing-direction; human-facing prose/HTML/compare/appendable→hsw default ON; basenames→hon). Pin SHA; validate with scripts/validate_content_system.py (full adapter); then apply acs_prompt_inject (application, human_facing_default, routes, apply_checklist). Do not vendor CGM source into ACS.

oio.notes: OIO issue-log ontology 0.1.0 at a4bba77b. Managed files are byte-identical (LF-normalized) to the prior install, so no OIO file changes are needed; recorded here for traceability and so the train mesh check sees the component. Pin SHA; do not follow moving main. On Windows the installer reports a PARTIAL install (coordination surface valid, OIO is the remaining step) and exits non-zero by design; the managed files themselves are already current.
